story.title: A small team that ships, measures, and owns the number.
story.sub: We're not a creative agency that picked up a few trades clients. Eureka was built from the ground up for owner-operators who care about cost-per-lead more than awards.

items.title: Cost-per-job, always.
items.body: It's the only number that matters to a contractor. Every dashboard, every report, every meeting starts there.

items.title: Month-to-month after 90 days.
items.body: If we can't hold you with results, no contract should. We give you the tracking we built — even if you leave.

items.title: Pick up the phone.
items.body: Your dedicated strategist gets a direct line. Not a ticketing system, not an inbox, not a chatbot.

items.title: No vanity metrics.
items.body: We don't put impressions in reports. We don't put "engagement rate" in reports. We put calls, forms, and jobs.
